# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 10/30–11/1，更新于 2026-10-26）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 10 个活动，华埠 Trick-or-Streets 万圣节讨糖、皇后区夜市万圣节收官场、法拉盛市政厅排灯节
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 6 个活动，Livingston 后备箱讨糖、Millburn 后备箱讨糖、泽西市 Newark Ave 万圣节家庭派对
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 9 个活动，小东京万圣节街区派对(21+)、哥斯拉入侵小东京快闪店、洛杉矶动漫展 L.A. Comic Con(15 周年)
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 8 个活动，华埠万圣节嘉年华(第 12 届)、亚洲艺术博物馆免费日+排灯节、Hiller 航空博物馆万圣节机库(周六/日)
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 8 个活动，西雅图亚洲艺术博物馆公众导览、Garfield 社区中心万圣节嘉年华、Wild Waves Fright Fest
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 7 个活动，ICA 草间弥生《LOVE IS CALLING》、Stone 动物园南瓜灯之夜(最后两晚)、塞勒姆 Ropes 宅邸(《女巫也疯狂》取景地)
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 9 个活动，菲尔德博物馆 Boo with SUE 夜场、公园露天电影《女巫也疯狂》、墨西哥艺术博物馆亡灵节特展
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 7 个活动，亚洲协会德州中心冥想工作坊、Discovery Green 万圣节 Scream on the Green、First Colony 商场万圣节(糖城)
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 6 个活动，Main Street Garden 露天电影《小丑回魂》、艺术区 Stage Fright 万圣节家庭节、沃斯堡科学历史博物馆 Ick or Treat
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 8 个活动，国立亚洲艺术博物馆(免费)、Eastern Market Hill-O-Ween、美国印第安人博物馆亡灵节
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 5 个活动，Fullerton 警局后备箱讨糖、纽波特 Back Bay 万圣节手作市集、尔湾 University UMC 后备箱讨糖
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 7 个活动，圣地亚哥动物园 HalGLOWeen(最后周末)、Carlsbad 小镇万圣节、科罗纳多 Orange Ave 商家讨糖
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 6 个活动，亚特兰大动物园 Boo at the Zoo、Ponce City Market 屋顶讨糖、Woodstock 万圣节骷髅派对
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 6 个活动，多伦多动物园 Boo at the Zoo、Black Creek 先民村万圣节、加拿大奇幻乐园 Tricks & Treats
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 7 个活动，华裔加拿大人博物馆《Momentum》体育展、本拿比鬼村(周五/六)、本拿比中央公园万圣节烟花

## City pages (English)
- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 10 events, e.g. Boo at the Bronx Zoo; Halloween at the Garden, Queens Botanical Garden; Chinatown Trick-or-Streets
- [New Jersey weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nj/): 6 events, e.g. Livingston Trunk or Treat; Millburn Annual Trunk or Treat; Halloween Family Bash, Jersey City
- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 9 events, e.g. L.A. Comic Con; Boo at the L.A. Zoo; Haunted Little Tokyo Block Party
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 8 events, e.g. Halloween Haunted Hangar, Hiller Aviation Museum; 12th Annual Chinatown Halloween Festival; Boo at the Zoo, San Francisco Zoo
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 8 events, e.g. Creepy Carnival at Garfield Community Center; Fright Fest at Wild Waves; BOO Seattle 2026
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 7 events, e.g. Jack-O'-Lantern Nights at Stone Zoo; Ropes Mansion, Salem; Trick-or-Treating on Broadway, South Boston
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 9 events, e.g. Family Field Nights: Boo with SUE; Movies in the Parks: Hocus Pocus; Día de Muertos Exhibition at the National Museum of Mexican Art
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 7 events, e.g. Scream on the Green; Fall-o-Ween Festival at First Colony Mall; Boo on the Boardwalk, Kemah
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 6 events, e.g. Movies in Main Street Garden: IT; Stage Fright: A Halloween Family Festival; Ick or Treat at the Fort Worth Museum of Science and History
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 8 events, e.g. Hill-O-Ween at Eastern Market; National Museum of Asian Art; Día de los Muertos at the National Museum of the American Indian
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 5 events, e.g. Fullerton Police Trunk or Treat; Halloween Craft Market & Kids Event, Back Bay Market; Trunk or Treat at University United Methodist Church
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 7 events, e.g. HalGLOWeen at the San Diego Zoo; Halloween in the Village, Carlsbad; Trick-or-Treat on Orange Avenue, Coronado
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 6 events, e.g. Boo at the Zoo, Zoo Atlanta; Trick-or-Treat on The Roof, Ponce City Market; Woodstock Halloween Skelebration
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 6 events, e.g. Boo at the Zoo, Toronto Zoo; Halloween at the Village, Black Creek; Tricks & Treats at Canada's Wonderland
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 7 events, e.g. Burnaby's Haunted Village; Central Spark, Burnaby; Momentum: Power and Identity in Sports, Chinese Canadian Museum
